tiers.name: Foundation Readiness
tiers.summary: Establish the scope, gaps, owners, and remediation sequence for a first or newly expanded compliance target.
tiers.idealFor: Teams that need a defensible baseline before committing to a larger readiness program.
includes: Initial control and evidence gap register
Readiness checkpoint and independent-review handoff notes

tiers.name: Managed Readiness
tiers.summary: Operate readiness as a recurring program so controls, evidence, exceptions, and ownership stay current.
tiers.idealFor: Growing teams preparing for a customer, assessor, certification-body, or regulator review on an active timeline.
includes: Control-owner working sessions and readiness scorecards
Ongoing remediation tracking and assessor handoff preparation

tiers.name: Assurance Engineering
tiers.summary: Pair readiness leadership with hands-on technical remediation and evidence automation across the engineering stack.
tiers.idealFor: Teams with material technical gaps, multiple environments or frameworks, or a compressed independent-review timeline.
includes: Hands-on cloud, IAM, SDLC, logging, and data-control remediation where in scope
Intensive pre-review exercises and independent assessor coordination support
